_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: TOP DATA ASK (mid-July): can the COCI course report be exported WITH the contact-hours columns colleges enter at course approval? Then the tab can rank the queue by computed alignment so staff clear the near-auto-approvable ones first before the Curriculum Institute. Fallback if not: we already hold every ⏳ In-progress (college, TMC) pair from the COCI program export and can use that as the queue.

Try the new Sierra features: pick who you are at the top (it's required now), ask a question, then hit 👍 or 👎 and drop a note — that's the training signal. Ask the same question as a Student vs an Administrator to see the voice change, and tell me where the tailoring should go further.

Decision: green-light the Sierra Training tab Phase 1? Say go and the next session builds it.
